video_title: Automated Sales Dashboard Creation with n8n and Lovable
description: This video demonstrates how to create an automated sales dashboard using two distinct workflows in n8n. The first workflow ingests sales data from incoming emails, parses it with an AI agent, and updates a Google Sheet. The second workflow exposes this data via a secure webhook, which is then used by Lovable to build and display a dynamic, real-time sales dashboard with various charts and metrics.

transcription.speaker: Host
transcription.text: Hello everyone and welcome to another lesson. I'm very happy to have you here with me today.

transcription.speaker: Host
transcription.text: Today we're going to do an exciting sales dashboard.

transcription.speaker: Host
transcription.text: So the idea is today we're going to be able to, I mean, all of us, we have income. I mean, most of the people who watch my channel are people who have side income, side streams of income, and they make money on the side.

transcription.speaker: Host
transcription.text: And I thought that maybe we can do an automation and tie that up with a lovable interface so we can do a sales dashboard that will give us the current sales, this month sales, past month sales, and also a year overview with pie charts. So we're going to do that today and I'm going to explain to you how we're going to do that step by step.

workflows.objective: Automatically capture sales data from incoming emails, parse with AI, and store in Google Sheets database
steps: Email trigger watches for new unseen emails
Check if sender domain matches sales sources (Stripe, etc.)
Check if subject contains sales keywords (sold, sale, payment)
AI Agent (Deepseek R1) parses email and extracts structured data
Update Google Sheets database with product, price, date, type
workflows.output: Structured sales record in Google Sheets

workflows.objective: Expose sales data via authenticated webhook for external dashboard consumption
steps: Fetch all records from Google Sheets sales database
Aggregate all items into single response
Respond to webhook with complete sales data
workflows.output: JSON array of all sales records

workflows.objective: Create visual sales dashboard using AI-powered no-code platform
steps: Write detailed prompt describing dashboard requirements
Attach reference image for visual style
Review and iterate on generated dashboard
Connect to webhook API for live data

task_chains: Email Received → Domain Check → Subject Check → AI Parse → Google Sheets Update
Webhook Request → Authorization → Fetch Data → Aggregate → JSON Response
Prompt + Image → Lovable Generation → Dashboard Review → Webhook Connection → Live Dashboard
